info.title: Consumer API for Freight Booking for Confirmation
info.description:
Provides functionality for managing the freight booking process when integrating SAP Business Network for Logistics with external systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Business Network for Logistics as the consumer of the API.
SAP Business Network for Logistics calls the defined endpoints within other systems.

x-sap-shortText: Enables carriers to manage the freight booking process.

externalDocs.description: Click here to access detailed implementation documentation.

post.summary: Creates or updates a freight booking request
post.description:
Creates/updates a freight booking request in another system.
SAP Business Network for Logistics calls this interface when an ordering party creates/updates a freight booking request.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The freight booking request must be created or updated.

post.description:
Cancels a freight booking request in an external system.
SAP Business Network for Logistics calls this interface when an ordering party cancels a freight booking request.
The API implementation must support `at least once` delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The freight booking request must be canceled.

post.summary: Creates or updates a freight booking waybill information
post.description:

SAP Business Network for Logistics calls this interface when an ordering party creates or updates a freight booking waybill notification.
The API implementation must support at least once delivery.
The implementation must be prepared that the endpoint could be called multiple times.

typeCode.description:
Represents the product type. A product type describes the nature of products and establishes the basic properties for
products of this type.
* 1 | Material
          Tangible product that can be created and thus represents a commercial value.
          Its manufacture/production is time-independent from its consumption/use.
          A material can be traded, used in manufacture, consumed, or produced.
* 2 | Service Product
          Intangible product that describes the rendering of service. The rendering of a service coincides in time with its use.
* 3 | Individual Material
          An individual material is a material that only occurs once in the real world and therefore describes a
          uniquely-identifiable material. It can also be a material that will only exist in the future.
* 4 | Warranty
          A guarantee to vouch for defects or faults in the product purchased that is valid for a specific period of
          time. The type and scope of this service is defined in the warranty.
* 5 | Intellectual Property
          An intangible product consisting of the inalienable property that is acquired by an act of creation.
* 6 | Entitlement Product
          A sellable product that describes the right to use a material or service.

transportationDocumentTypeCode.description:
Represents the type of a transportation-related document.
* 1   Transportation Request
      A transportation document of the type transportation request.
      A transportation request is a request to transport goods from one or more shippers to one or more
      consignees in accordance with agreed terms and conditions. In an intracompany integration scenario, the
      request can represent either an order-based transportation requirement (preliminary) or a delivery-based
      transportation requirement (final). In a B2B scenario, it can represent a forwarding quotation or a
      forwarding order. A transportation request can also include the assignment of transportation stages.
* 2   Transportation Order
          A transportation document of the type transportation order.
          A transportation order is an order from an ordering party to a carrier to transport goods from one or more
          shippers to one or more consignees in accordance with agreed terms and conditions. The order can also
          include the assignment of vehicle resources and transportation stages.
          The order can also have the character of a freight request for quotation that is sent to a carrier.

A coded representation of a contract condition in transportation that applies to a transportation stage of a transportation order with the category as freight booking. Also defines which of the involved parties is responsible for organizing the transportation for this specific stage.
* 3 Special Agreement for Full Loading Transport
  Appliance of unpublished special agreement signed between a customer and the carrier (mandatory
  requested by the consignor) for full load transport.
* 4 Combined Transport
  A transport which involves more than one mode of transportation.
* 5 FIATA Combined Transport Bill of Lading
  Standard conditions of a combined transport bill of lading issued by FIATA.
* 6 Freight Forwarders National Conditions
  The contract and carriage conditions as established by freight forwarders on a national basis.
* 7 Normal Tariff, Parcels Transport
  Appliance of the published legal tariff in case of parcels transport (required or not by the consignor).
* 8 Normal Tariff, Full Loading Transport
  Appliance of the published legal tariff in case of full load transport (required or not by the consignor).
* 9 Ordinary
  Carrier will choose the cheapest tariff in the legally published tariffs for parcels or full load transports (no tariff required by the consignor).
* 10 Port to Port
  The transport will only be port to port, no inland transport shall be provided under the contract.
* 11 CMR
  Carnet Conditions in accordance with the convention of the contract for the international carriage of goods by road.
* 12 Special Tariff, Parcels Transport
  Appliance of the legally published special tariff in case or parcels transport (tariff requested by the consignor).
* 13 Special Tariff, Full Transport
  Appliance of the legally published special tariff in case of full load transport (tariff requested by the consignor).
* 14 Through Transport
  The transport that is contracted not only from port to port, but from one inland location to another inland location.
* 27 Door-to-Door
  The carrier is responsible for the intermodal carriage of cargo including both pre-carriage and oncarriage.
* 28 Door-to-Pier
  The carrier is responsible for the intermodal carriage of cargo including pre-carriage, but excluding on-carriage.
* 29 Pier-to-Door
  The carrier is responsible for the intermodal carriage of cargo including on-carriage, but excluding pre-carriage.
* 30 Pier-to-Pier
  The carrier of intermodal cargo is only responsible for the main carriage.
* 31 Space Cancellation
  Noted indication that space previously allocated on a means of transport has been cancelled.
* 32 Mini Landbridge Service
  Cargo moving from a coastal port for delivery at an inland location or cargo received at an inland location
  moving to a coastal port for subsequent ocean transportation.
* 34 Speed Level - Required
  Maximum speed required on an itinerary or part of this itinerary to be able to assume some services.
* 35 Speed Level - Adopted
  Real speed used on an itinerary or part of this itinerary (for technical reasons, some limitation can be
  imposed or some higher speed could be used).
* 36 Normal Tariff, Less than Full Load Transport
  Application of the published legal tariff in case of less than full load transport (required or not by the
  consignor).
* 37 Re-Expedition Special Tariff
  Indication that a special tariff must be used in the case of a re-expedition.
* 38 Transport Arrangement by the Requester
  The service requester has the responsibility of making transport arrangement.
* 39 Transport Arrangement by the Provider
  The service provider has the responsibility of making transport arrangement.
* 40 Transport Arrangement by the Patient
  The patient has the responsibility of making transport arrangement.

* BPO Truck Being Transported

              A road vehicle capable of carrying goods with an attached trailer which is being carried on another means

              transport.

* BPT Roller Cage

              long edge.

              Postal item, which is conveyed individually, with only the wrapping provided by the mailer for protection.
